findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url_to_markdown, url_metadata, url_links, url_check, email_domain_check, robots_check · Private data: dns_lookup, domain_whois · Public sink: email_domain_check, domain_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: url_to_markdown, url_metadata, url_links, url_check, email_domain_check, robots_check · Private data: dns_lookup, domain_whois · Public sink: email_domain_check, domain_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
